blocks.brow: Free live webinar for Australian C-Suite executives
blocks.heading: Solving the **Hardest Enterprise Problems** with AI
blocks.description:
Most AI advice aimed at executives is theory, AI 101, or a vendor selling a platform. In 60 minutes you'll see the four business problems AI has just made cheap enough to solve, with the case studies and the dollar figures behind them.

**Thursday 3 September 2026 · 11:00 AM AEST · Live on Zoom**  
50 minutes live + 10 min Q\&A

blocks.heading: Your business problems didn't change. **The cost of solving them did.**
blocks.description:
For years the upgrade was too expensive. So was the custom build, the data project, the legacy replacement. You parked them.

AI has rewritten the maths on all four. The roadmap you shelved three years ago is realistic now. The system your executive team keeps asking for can be built in weeks instead of quarters. The legacy platform that breaks every Monday morning can finally be replaced.

If you sit in the C-Suite at an Australian business, someone pitches you on AI most weeks. Almost none of it shows you what an AI build actually costs and returns in a company like yours. This session does.

faqs.question: Will this be recorded?
faqs.answer: Yes. Register and we'll send you the replay even if you can't make it live.

faqs.question: Is this technical?
faqs.answer: No. It's built for business leaders. We talk cost, time and return, not code.

faqs.question: Is this a pitch in disguise?
faqs.answer: No. The 60 minutes are teaching. At the end Ulysses offers a free 1:1 consultation to anyone who wants to talk through their own business, and that's the extent of it.

faqs.question: What size business is this for?
faqs.answer: Mid-to-large Australian enterprises. If you run custom software, a CRM or ERP, or a legacy system blocking new features, and you have a say over the budget, you're the right person in the room.
